-82.46630,27.27240.name: Fertility Center & Applied Genetics of Florida
-82.46630,27.27240.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Julio E. Pabon, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

-0.09665,51.51483.name: CREATE Fertility, London St Paul's
-0.09665,51.51483.desc: A fertility clinic licensed and inspected by the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Authority. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. The HFEA licenses every clinic in the United Kingdom, inspects them, and publishes findings and success rates clinic by clinic. No other fertility regulator publishes at this level, which makes the UK the one country where this sector can be read rather than estimated.

-91.87000,31.17000.name: Southeast Louisiana Veterans Health Care System
-91.87000,31.17000.type: Animal Welfare Act veterans affairs hospital
-91.87000,31.17000.desc: Veterans Affairs hospital registered with USDA APHIS under the Animal Welfare Act, certificate 72-V-0003. This is the address on the registration. A research registration is issued to an organisation rather than to a building, so for a university it is usually the research administration office and the animals are elsewhere on campus or in another city. Rats, mice and birds bred for research are excluded from the Act's definition of an animal — the overwhelming majority of animals used, and the great majority of the genetically altered ones. What is covered here is dogs, cats, primates, rabbits, guinea pigs, hamsters and farm animals. The rest is counted nowhere.

-123.17252,49.10130.name: Canadian Wildlife Service
-123.17252,49.10130.status: Certificate of GAP Last visit: interim, February 2025
-123.17252,49.10130.desc: An institution certified by the Canadian Council on Animal Care for its use of animals in science. A site of Environment and Climate Change Canada. Certificate of GAP Last visit: interim, February 2025. CCAC certification is a condition of federal research funding rather than a licence, so an institution outside it is not necessarily outside the work — it may simply not take federal money. The CCAC publishes names and certificate status and no addresses, so this point marks the institution rather than the building where animals are held.

-70.66930,-33.44890.name: SAG — Servicio Agrícola y Ganadero
-70.66930,-33.44890.desc: Chile permits engineered crops to be grown for seed export but not for domestic sale, making it a significant producer of engineered seed that its own farmers cannot plant. Counter-season seed multiplication for northern hemisphere companies is a large and little-discussed part of the world seed system.
